I will still farm the way I have seen work here, not do anything fancy. On my land, wheat and maize feed the house and bring steady money, so I will keep most of the ground in the wheat-maize rotation and leave a smaller piece for cotton. I do not like cutting fertilizer too hard. If wheat or maize goes yellow, the yield is gone, and that hurts more than wasting a little fertilizer. I have well water, so I will use irrigation on the key times and not wait for the sky if the ground is dry. For seed, I will use the kinds people around me plant when I see they come up even and give full ears or full bolls. On wheat I will put a heavier base fertilizer and one topdressing; on maize I will feed more after it gets knee-high; on cotton I will spread the fertilizer over the season because it grows longer. I do not want too many sprays because they cost money, but I will not skip them if insects or disease start showing. With 12.4 mu and only 2 people at home, I will keep the work simple and use the same tillage habits as before so I can finish on time.
